verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Convex supports external AI agents: an official MCP server, an agent setup prompt, and compatibility with coding agents. None of it documents an AI assistant built into the Convex dashboard that writes queries, debugs errors, or explains the backend. Support for external agents is a different capability and earns no credit for an in-dashboard assistant.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain my backend
